offering_description.value: Provides a digital remittance platform that lets immigrants and individuals send money across borders via mobile app and website. Also offers business payments and related digital financial services. Delivers payouts to bank accounts, mobile wallets and cash pickup through a network of partners.

primary_services.value: international money transfers; cross-border business payments; digital wallet and multi-currency accounts; foreign exchange conversion

customer_segment.value: B2C: immigrants and individuals sending money to family abroad; B2B: small businesses and platforms making cross-border payments

end_markets.value: consumer remittances; cross-border payments; financial services

revenue_model.value: transaction or usage fees: transfer fees per transaction; transaction or usage fees: foreign exchange spread on currency conversion
revenue_model.category: transaction or usage fees; transaction or usage fees

value_chain_position.value: financial intermediary: takes in sender funds and pays out through bank, wallet and cash pickup partners to recipients; software / platform: operates mobile and web money transfer platform for consumers and businesses

geography_served.value: global: Sending from the US, Canada, Europe, Australia and other markets to receiving countries such as India, Mexico and the Philippines

specialization.value: related lines: consumer remittances, business payments and digital wallet services built on one payments platform

distribution_channels.value: online: mobile app and website used directly by senders; partners / resellers: payout partners and embedded partner platforms for business payments

regulatory_exposure.value: high: licensed money transmitter, FinCEN, state regulators, CFPB, FCA and other national authorities, AML and sanctions rules
